My dear Miss [name deliberately obscured][^2]
I hope I am not tormenting you but on account of other engagements I am anxious to know whether you could come this week or next. The week that begins with the 7th and has Ash Wednesday in it, I am going to spend at [Mr Wilson](/person/1541)’s but the one after that I shall be at home again if that suited you better than within the next fortnight

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^2]: Possibly [Elizabeth Missing Sewell](/person/1301), a number of whose letters from CMY are marked in this way.
